$comment: Machine-readable brand tokens. The prototype builder and scripts/brand_render.py read this. Keep in sync with visual-identity.md (brand_render.py check compares them). Filled by /setup.

colors.$comment: Hex, #RRGGBB. Images use background and text; the gradient phrase and the glow run primary into accent.

fonts.$comment: A Google Fonts family name (Inter), or a font file under brand/ (fonts/Heading.woff2).

logo.$comment: Paths under brand/, for example logos/primary.svg and logos/mark.svg. The *_inverse files are for the opposite background (theme=inverse); optional.
